benchmark: PD++ Figures 11-12, paper-scale reconstructed bunny experiment

local_assumptions.material: Young modulus, Poisson ratio and density are local placeholders; not recovered author parameters
local_assumptions.contact: dmin, dhat and contact stiffness are local explicit values, identical across methods
local_assumptions.duration: 4.0 s / 400 steps; declared experimental horizon, not recovered author duration. Completion of steps does not certify sliding off.
local_assumptions.resolution: Eight intrinsic levels: 1443,2663,4834,8608,15651,28185,50268,90000 vertices; matches paper endpoint scale approximately, not author meshes.
local_assumptions.acceptance: No tuning per method. Success only certifies this configured run, not paper reproduction.
local_assumptions.solver: RMS Newton velocity decrement <=1e-4 m/s for every method (tight threshold used for quantitative comparisons in paper Sec.8.2.2); fixed 1000-iteration safety cap. No tolerance relaxation on failure.
local_assumptions.timing: One serial run per method with 8 IPC/BLAS threads; report wall and physics time separately. No repeated performance claims.
